current_date: July 2021 (formally reviewed with no revisions; first published Nov 2013, updated after re-consultation Dec 2017)
current_evidence: Rother's 'What you need to submit' planning page links only this 'Planning Validation Checklist July 2021' as the latest checklist, planning.data.gov.uk records the same URL for Rother (entry 2026-10-16), and a web search found no newer list.

issues.detail: Grokbot missed 10 local list items: Affordable Housing Statement (where adopted policy requires affordable housing); Energy Statement (major developments in North East Bexhill); Land Contamination Assessment (sites where contamination is known or suspected, or nearby land, where ground works are proposed); Noise Impact Assessment (all plant installations, noisy activities near sensitive uses, and noise-sensitive development near major roads or transport, excluding householder); Open Space Assessment (major development of 10+ dwellings or 1,000 sqm+ that loses open space, or any loss of playing field); Pre-application Engagement Statement (major proposals over 50 dwellings or 1,000 sqm commercial); Refuse Disposal Strategy (any application creating one or more new dwellings); Structural Survey (conversion of a traditional agricultural building); Sunlight Daylight Assessment (structure over 20m high, or possible adverse impact on neighbours' light); Flood Risk Exception Test Evidence (relevant applications in Zones 2/3a/3b, item 9, which is separate from the sequential test).
issues.evidence: Section 2 local list items 1, 5, 9, 14, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21, 22, e.g. 'Refuse Disposal Strategy: Any application resulting in the creation of one of more new dwellings'; 'Sunlight Daylight Assessment: Any application where the resultant structure would be over 20m in height'

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none)' (national requirements only). But several local items apply to any application for planning permission, which includes householder: Heritage Statement / Assessment of Significance (affecting a designated heritage asset or its setting), Tree Survey / Arboricultural Statement (protected or significant trees), Archaeological Report (ground works in an Archaeological Notification Area), Ground Stability (all coastal sites), Land Contamination, and Flood Risk Assessment in Zones 2/3 (only minor domestic extensions with no new dwelling or bedroom are excluded). Householder is excluded only from the Ecology item and one Noise category.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement (1): 'Any application for planning permission affecting a designated Heritage Asset or its setting'; Ecological Survey: 'except for change of use and development to an existing dwelling (householder)'

issues.detail: Almost every requirement is marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', but the source gives triggers by development type and location, not only Full planning. Outline and Reserved matters are recorded as '(none)', yet items such as FRA, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan, Ecology, Archaeology, Affordable Housing, EIA and CIL apply to outline and major applications too. Works to trees is recorded as '(none)', but the Tree Survey / Arboricultural Statement also applies to 'any applications for consent to fell or remove a tree subject to a Tree Preservation Order'. Listed building consent shows only 'Photographs / Photomontages', when the Heritage Statement (Assessment of Significance) and the LBC Design and Access Statement both apply to LBC.
issues.evidence: Tree Survey: 'Any applications for consent to fell or remove a tree subject to a Tree Preservation Order'; Heritage Statement (1) covers Listed Building and Conservation Area Consent

issues.detail: 'Marketing / vacancy evidence (loss of use)' is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The source's Viability and Marketing Statement applies to planning applications for a change of use involving loss of community, tourist or employment space, and to conversion of agricultural buildings to residential, not to prior approval. 'Lighting Assessment' is placed only under Advertisement consent, but the source applies it to any application including floodlighting or significant external lighting.
issues.evidence: Viability and Marketing Statement: 'Any application for a change of use which involves the loss of, or a reduction in, ...'; Lighting: 'Any application including or for floodlighting, or any significant amount of external lighting'

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are fragments that do not say when the item is required. Flood Risk Assessment: 'A matrix is also provided...' (the real trigger is FZ1 sites over 1 ha with critical drainage problems, and development in FZ2/3a/3b). Travel Plan: 'The Travel Plan should include details of targets... 27.' (the real trigger is major applications of 50+ dwellings or 1,000 sqm+ commercial). Drainage Strategy / SuDS: uses FRA text (the real trigger is major development with surface water drainage, plus new development at Fairlight Cove). Archaeology: ends in a broken URL fragment 'g-and-enhancing-the-historic-environment/...' (the real trigger is ground works in an Archaeological Notification Area, works affecting a Scheduled Monument, or major development). Retail: omits the 500 sqm threshold. Habitats Regulations: 'to inform a Habitats Regulations Assessment.' Agricultural dwelling: covers only the functional-need test and omits new agricultural buildings, new rural enterprises and removal of occupancy conditions. The tab item for designated sites is cut off mid-word ('Biodiversity Action Plan (BAP').
issues.evidence: Travel Plan: 'Any major application of 50 or more dwellings or 1,000sqm or more of commercial floorspace.'; Retail Assessment: 'Any retail application comprising floor space of 500 sq m or more.'; Sustainable Drainage: 'Any major development involving surface water drainage'

issues.detail: Three rows ('Housing mix / dwelling standards (NDSS, accessible homes)', 'Self-build / custom build information' and 'Water efficiency / water usage statement') are built from an introductory sentence about the council's intention to bring in future DaSA policy standards. They are not validation requirements in the list. 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' is a fragment of the site plan guidance, not a separate local requirement.
issues.evidence: Introduction: 'the Council's intention to introduce new standards for water efficiency, residential internal space ... a requirement for self-build units on larger housing schemes' (noted as not yet part of the development plan)

issues.detail: Four of the six tab_items are submission and drawing process text, not local requirements: annotating plans on Planning Portal, typical location plan scale, the 'one paper copy' request ('at the present time'), and the scale bar note. The tab omits the 29 numbered local list items, which appear only in the app-type rows.
issues.evidence: 'it can assist in the speedy processing of your application if (at the present time) you can forward one paper copy'

issues.detail: 'Photographs / Photomontages' under Listed building consent is mislabelled. The excerpt is the national LBC drawings requirement (plans and drawings showing the works and their impact, detailed drawings at 1:50 minimum, joinery details), not a photographs requirement. Photographs are only 'very exceptionally' accepted in place of drawings. 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' mislabels Rother's Ground Stability Assessment and omits its key trigger: all coastal sites.
issues.evidence: 'Very exceptionally photographs of an existing situation or indicating the proposal may be accepted. APPLICATIONS FOR LISTED BUILDING CONSENT ...'

issues.detail: The date is correct but the list content is old. The July 2021 review made no revisions, so the content dates from the December 2017 update. It does not mention Biodiversity Net Gain, fire statements or air quality, and it refers to old NPPF paragraph numbers (e.g. 'paragraph 89'). The 'Outdated (>2y)' flag is right. Users should be warned that the list predates the current national requirements.
issues.evidence: 'formally reviewed in July 2021 with no revisions'; Retail Assessment cites 'National Planning Policy Framework paragraph 89'
issues.grok_comment: The list is old, but the content does not date only from December 2017: the history line records a minor amendment in February 2018, NPPF changes in September 2018 and further minor revisions in November 2018 before the July 2021 review.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Content was amended up to November 2018, not December 2017. Still old and pre-dates BNG.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Rother list (July 2021, last reviewed with no changes), and its date is correct. The extraction is poor: it missed about 10 of the 29 local items (refuse, sunlight/daylight, contamination, noise, open space, pre-app engagement, energy, structural survey, affordable housing, exception test), lists Householder as having no local requirements, and has many fragmentary or mis-assigned triggers.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
